hook: Your 3D printer could be a side business
script: Your 3D printer could be a side business. Bambu Lab just announced Bambu Circle: certified local shops that print, repair, and teach. It starts in the Netherlands, then Germany and France next year. Bambu says fifty-eight percent of its Dutch users want to earn money printing. Should it come to Canada?
cta: Should Bambu Circle come to Canada?
